messages:
jordan_sales: FYI — ACME (pilot customer) just asked to add an open model to our catalog: 'open-instruct-42B' and they want:
- version pinning to a specific commit/tag
- availability in eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1
- a quantized (int8) variant for cost reasons

They flagged latency target ~200ms p95 for short-chat queries. cc @maria_prod for prioritization and @alex_eng_ml for perf/compat checks.

maria_prod: thanks. quick triage: is this an onboarding (catalog + infra) or a dedicated private deployment request? any data residency notes from ACME?

jordan_sales: it's for our hosted API (they prefer not to manage infra). No extra data residency requirements beyond storing logs in EU for their EU team. They want the model available to their tenant only (access control + region pin).

alex_eng_ml: I can run a quick compatibility check. Which model repo/tag exactly? and any preferred tokenizer/format? We need to know if it's a HF/transformers artifact or a custom format.

jordan_sales: repo link: https://hf.co/open-instruct/open-instruct-42b v1.1. Tokenizer: huggingface/bpe. They mentioned a quantized float16->int8 pipeline works well for latency, but asked if we can host both full-fp16 and int8.

sam_support: rolling into backlog intake — customer impact = P2 (paid pilot), asked for ETA within 3 weeks for EU region. We should confirm if that is realistic before committing.

maria_prod: Initial product asks:
1) Acceptance criteria: model loads in eu-west-1, passes perf smoke (p95 <= 250ms for 32-token gen), serves int8 variant with <=1.4x quality drop measured on their eval set, RBAC so only ACME org can call it.
2) Launch criteria: perf baseline + infra cost estimate + SLOs documented + docs + e2e test in staging.

alex_eng_ml: Plan for triage:
- Step 1: try local load on our latest runtime with FP16 + int8 conversion (1 day)
- Step 2: run perf profile on A100-p4 and on our cheaper T4-equivalent for cost-sensitivity (2 days)
- Step 3: validate tokenization and eval sample from ACME (1 day)

If all green, estimating 1 week to stage rollout and another week for region deployment/QA. That stretches to ~2.5 weeks total.

jordan_sales: I'll push back on the 3-week ask and propose 2.5 weeks, sounds fair. ACME wants version pinning APIs so they can lock to v1.1 — do we have an existing endpoint for tenant-scoped pinned model versions?

maria_prod: We have model-version pinning in roadmap but not GA. For hosted we can create a tenant-scoped mapping as a short-term rule: maintain a pinned registry that maps (org,model)->model_variant and route accordingly. Needs infra + console change. I propose we scope a minimal API (admin-only) plus a UI follow-up.

sam_support: Action items assigned:
- jordan_sales: ask ACME for a small eval set (10 prompts) + consent for perf testing (today).
- alex_eng_ml: run compatibility + perf profile (ETA 3 working days).
- maria_prod: open a backlog entry with ACME priority, add acceptance & launch criteria above, and flag for region ops (eu, ap-southeast) — assign to eng-platform once triage ok.

alex_eng_ml: quick note on quantization: some HF checkpoints use fused layers that break naive int8 conversion. If that happens we may need a patched kernel or fallback to fp16 for that variant. I'll call it out in the compatibility report.

jordan_sales: ACME agreed to send eval set — they'll email it into this thread. They also asked if we can expose a "pin_version" field in the Create Deployment API.

maria_prod: For now we can accept an org-scoped override in our deployment metadata: {
  `org_id`: "acme",
  `model_name`: "open-instruct-42B",
  `pinned_version`: "v1.1",
  `variant`: "int8"
}
Include this as implementation note in the backlog ticket. UI + RBAC follow-ups to be separate tickets.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please add an epic link when creating the backlog issue: #EPIC-Model-Onboarding.

sam_support: created backlog ticket PROD-3421 with the details and acceptance criteria, linked EPIC-Model-Onboarding. Assigned to maria_prod for prioritization and alex_eng_ml for initial investigation.

maria_prod: Thanks. I'll mark this as customer-driven (pilot) and propose we schedule it in next sprint if compatibility checks pass. If alex flags kernel work, we'll re-scope to a follow-up sprint and communicate to ACME.

alex_eng_ml: starting compatibility tests now. Will report back here by EOD with results.

jordan_sales: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll hold off on any commitment until we have alex's perf numbers. :thumbsup:
thread_text: Customer asks to onboard 'open-instruct-42B' with version pinning + region availability for ACME pilot; triage, acceptance criteria, and action items discussed by product/eng/support.
